Class ScheduledWorkout

java.lang.Object
com.kineticfitness.model.ScheduledWorkout
public class ScheduledWorkout extends Object
One planned training session: what, when, how long, whether to remind, and whether it has been done.

Immutable — withStatus(ScheduleStatus) and rescheduledTo(LocalDate, LocalTime) return new instances rather than mutating, so a workout can never be left half-updated.

Date and time are real LocalDate / LocalTime values, not strings. That is what makes it possible to ask "is this due yet?" at all, and it means an unparseable date is rejected at the form instead of being stored.

US-10 — Schedule a workout. US-22 — Set an activity reminder.
